description: Match session authorization, live snapshots and results, replayed by reduceMatch (lib/protocol/match-state.ts).
format: Events are signed (BIP-340, zero aux randomness) with keys derived as sha256('blueline-vector:' + name). Expected outcomes are written by hand from docs/protocol.

cases.name: session-handover
cases.description: The match moves to another device: session 2 replaces session 1. From the handover on, session 1's snapshots and results are refused.

cases.name: forged-handover
cases.description: Only the match authority hands over, always to the next session on top of the current one; strangers cannot write.

cases.name: session-window
cases.description: A session writes only inside its window, and a snapshot must carry its own session's authorization.

cases.name: confirm-and-correct
cases.description: Players confirm or dispute one exact result. A correction replaces it and its verdicts no longer count; only seated players give verdicts; a second result must name the one it replaces.

cases.name: public-stake
cases.description: A stake is only written into a private, encrypted match; a public founding with a stake is invalid, so no match exists.

cases.name: private-match
cases.description: A private match: founding and snapshots are encrypted to the match key from the link; the agreed stake is inside.

cases.name: chunked-log
cases.description: A long throw log travels in hash-chained pieces; the result names the chain's head, piece count and size.

cases.name: unknown-version
cases.description: A snapshot in a newer format version is kept, not executed.
